changeSummary: Add first-launch update choice, optional background downloads, local verified package retention and cancellation; correct the distinction between signed packages and unsigned manifests.
dateRationale: This policy revision adds an opt-in automatic package request trigger and durable local package storage. October 16, 2026 identifies this new policy revision, not an unchanged-policy deployment. Reconfirm the effective date when publishing this pending feature.
scope: Review of the update-preferences feature relative to 7670212d. Other service processing remains covered by the prior source baseline; this change introduces no additional recipient beyond GitHub release/download infrastructure.

evidence.source: PLVS: src/lib/updateController.js; src/hooks/useUpdateController.js; src-tauri/src/update_runtime.rs; src-tauri/src/update_cache.rs; src-tauri/src/update_worker.rs; src/components/UpdateSurfaces.jsx
evidence.notes: Reviewed request gates and native preference rechecks; manual requests are separate. Fresh users make no automatic request before saving a choice. Existing users retain checking only. Packages are signature and signed-version checked, kept installation-locally, replaced atomically, and removed when automatic downloading is revoked. No audio, measurements, feedback payload or PLVS user identifier is added to update requests. Helper installation uses cached bytes without a new network request.

Startup and twelve-hour coordinator checks; updater plugin excluded for preview identity. Native logging uses a 2 MB rotation threshold and KeepSome(3); pending crash enrichment requests 200 log lines.

evidence.source: PLVS: src/components/FeedbackDialog.jsx; src/components/CrashReportDialog.jsx; src/lib/feedback.js; src/lib/crashReporting.js; src/lib/feedbackDiagnostics.js; src-tauri/src/feedback_diagnostics.rs; src-tauri/src/crash_report.rs
evidence.notes: Feedback diagnostics default off and are included only when selected; reviewed payload submission is explicit. Crash reports remain local until submission, with combined pending/suppressed retention of five. Diagnostic journals are bounded by 100 records and 64 KiB; frontend fields are allowlisted.
Homepage requests public GitHub release metadata and submits the newsletter form to list.plvs.soundoer.com. Presentation work preserves policy prose and the existing effective date.

evidence.source: soundoer-newsletter: src/subscribe.js; src/db.js; src/feedback.js; src/server.js; src/start.js; README.md; .env.example
evidence.notes: Local clean service checkout: SQLite subscriber state; unsubscribe changes status without deleting the row; feedback/crash routes validate and email rather than insert into the subscriber DB. Origin/user-agent are included in messages. Application logging is disabled and rate limiting is five requests per minute. Documentation identifies SES and the example SMTP hostname uses us-east-1.

limitations: Source review of a pending feature, not a publication approval or verification of GitHub provider retention. Confirm final feature behavior and this policy effective date before website or desktop publication. Earlier service deployment and mailbox-retention limitations still apply.
